title: plugin-auth: Setup's Register SAML Provider answers 400 SAML_REGISTER_FAILED for every complete form (the bridge sends no idpMetadata.entityID)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPxYq1wQmUNWvMZkC

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location and a measured reach. Found by the #30300 dev while measuring that card's doors (os-dev report 6652003986 on #30300, `out_of_scope_findings`, class a), on `main` `bfca0efb` with `@better-auth/sso` 1.7.12. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

Business reason: an administrator who sets up enterprise sign-in from Setup → SSO Providers → Register SAML Provider cannot register any SAML provider there: every complete form is refused. The only working path today is the vendor's raw `/sso/register` endpoint, which Setup does not expose.

Reader who acts: `domain:server`, `plugin-auth` `register-sso-provider.ts` (`runRegisterSamlProviderFromForm`), the bridge behind `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/register-saml`.

Dedupe (open and closed): `SAML_REGISTER_FAILED` (nearest #10716, closed: lowercase error codes, not this), `Register SAML Provider entityID`, `samlConfig idpMetadata entityID` → none. **New.**

## What happens (measured by the #30300 dev)

1. Setup → SSO Providers → Register SAML Provider, a complete form.
2. `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/register-saml` → 400 `SAML_REGISTER_FAILED`: `[body.samlConfig.idpMetadata] idpMetadata.entityID is required when IdP metadata XML is not provided`.
3. The same provider registers through the vendor's `/sso/register` when `samlConfig.idpMetadata.entityID` is sent (200, one `sys_sso_provider` row).

Transcript: `/mnt/project-files/server-seat3/30300/door1-run1.out` (project folder).

## Reading

`runRegisterSamlProviderFromForm` builds `samlConfig` with no `idpMetadata`; the vendor schema in `@better-auth/sso` 1.7.12 requires `idpMetadata.entityID` or metadata XML. A reading, not confirmed by a fix.

## Expected

A complete Register SAML Provider form registers the provider, as the vendor endpoint does with the same values.
